views.label: Classify by consequence
views.note: Actions are classified by consequence; routine actions stay autonomous under guardrails.

views.label: Human decides in a time box
views.note: A high-consequence action pauses for a named reviewer to approve or reject within a time box.

views.label: Execute or drop, then log
views.note: Approved actions execute, rejected or timed-out actions are dropped, and the decision is logged.

segments.label: Human decides in a time box

cards.title: Oversight by design
items: Classify actions by consequence, not by habit
Gate only the irreversible or high-impact class behind a human
Keep the routine class autonomous under guardrails

cards.title: A decision in a time box
items: The agent pauses and the action is blocked until a named reviewer decides
The reviewer gets enough context to decide
A timeout drops the action rather than letting it through

cards.title: Recorded as evidence
items: The approver, the context and the decision are logged
This realises the EU AI Act Art. 14 human-oversight duty at the point of action
